<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file LICENSE.EXTRA contains additional licensing terms and conditions for distributing modified versions of the SJMCL software, building upon the GPLv3 license. It imposes requirements such as renaming the software when modified (unless only adding preset authentication servers), providing clear attribution to the original project, and documenting modifications appropriately. One clause requests that modified versions send version numbers with a custom prefix to a statistics server unless the modification falls under Clause 3, which exempts purely additive changes to authentication server presets.

While the mention of sending version data to a statistics server may raise privacy considerations, this is framed as a condition tied to distribution compliance rather than enforced by technical mechanisms in the code. There is no evidence in this file of malicious behavior such as data exfiltration, unauthorized network communication, or execution of remote code. The file itself is a static license text and does not contain executable commands or scripts. Such policy-based requests are within the scope of upstream project governance and do not constitute a supply-chain attack.

This file aligns with common open-source licensing practices where maintainers seek to track derivative distributions for attribution or analytics. No obfuscated code, dangerous system calls, or suspicious operations are present.
</details>

No network operations, file manipulations, or system modifications are performed by this file. It conforms to standard AUR packaging practices and contains no obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or execution directives.
